brief_rationale: The doctor consistently screens red flags, recognizes the gastric CA context, avoids overreach, and provides concrete next-step plans. However, in the initial message (turn 1) the model advised ‘奥美拉唑早上空腹吃一粒’ and ‘替普瑞酮饭后一次一粒’ before obtaining label-confirmed doses, and initially framed omeprazole as a plausible discharge medicine despite evidence that it was self-purchased and not part of the hospital bag—this constitutes a minor medication-execution error under RC3. That minor error caps the grade at 2. The trajectory also triggers and completes multiple high-order points (HO1–HO4) with meaningful impact, but the RC3 error prevents any grade above Borderline.
